candidates.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
candidates.abstract: We explore how generating a chain of thought before the final answer improves reasoning ability of large language models.

candidates.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
candidates.abstract: We show that fine-tuning language models on user instructions improves their ability to follow instructions.

candidates.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
candidates.abstract: We introduce BERT, a new language representation model pre-trained on large unlabeled text.

candidates.title: Attention Is All You Need
candidates.abstract: We propose the transformer, a simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms.

candidates.title: Cooking for Beginners: Simple Recipes for Home Cooks
candidates.abstract: A collection of easy recipes for people learning to cook at home.
